headline: Spider-Man and Miracleman clash on Avengers
post:
Hey fellow Marvel fans! We have a wild new comic update to share with you today. According to Screen Rant, Peter Parker has revealed the single hero he cannot stand, and they are unfortunately stuck working together on the same roster. Following the events of Avengers: Armageddon, a brand-new lineup has formed featuring Spider-Man alongside Captain Marvel, Wolverine, Daredevil, Luke Cage, and David Colton, also known as Miracleman.

Things get heated right away between the web-slinger and Colton. Spidey confronts Colton at Stark Tower after finding him destroying military weaponry. He accuses Colton of causing Thunderbolt Ross to blow up in Russia and make the world fear superheroes. Mayor Luke Cage even has to step in personally! This new Avengers team is already facing intense pressure, with S.H.I.E.L.D. targeting superheroes after a U.N. agreement, plus a massive threat from Mephisto and Doctor Doom.

Are you picking up the new Avengers issues yet? 

#MarvelComics #SpiderMan #Avengers
original_title: Spider-Man Names The 1 Marvel Superhero He Absolutely Can't Stand

headline: X-Men #94 Hits Heritage Auction Block
post:
Remember when low sales forced the X-Men comics into five years of reprints? Chris Claremont’s X-Men #94 completely changed the team forever and saved the series from cancellation, kicking off a massive 16-year revival era. 

Now, a CGC NM 9.4 copy of this vital Marvel issue is up for auction at Heritage with a starting bid of $2,600! This issue featured the second appearances of Storm, Nightcrawler, and Colossus, giving them their first proper mission as official team members.

What is your favorite vintage X-Men comic issue?

#XMen #MarvelComics #ChrisClaremont
original_title: This X-Men Comic Ended Five Years of Reprints, But It Also Changed the Team Forever

headline: Marvel announces new Hulk comic series
post:
Get ready for a brand new era for Bruce Banner and the Green Goliath. According to Screen Rant, Marvel has officially confirmed a fresh Hulk series launching next year in 2027.

Following explosive comic events involving the Infernal Hulk, the upcoming creative team of Chris Condon and Alessandro Cappuccio is bringing readers a fresh storyline in Hulk #1. This next chapter introduces a potential cure for Banner's gamma transformation, though purging the radiation from his cells comes with major risks. Stripping away the transformation could leave Banner chronically ill or emotionally hollow without his inner rage.

Fans can look forward to this exciting new comic release arriving on May 1st, 2027. Will you be picking up this new Hulk book when it hits comic shops next year?

#Marvel #Hulk #Comics
original_title: Marvel Officially Announces New Hulk Series For 2027

headline: David Harbour confirms his DCU return
post:
David Harbour is officially heading back to the DCU! The star recently shared that he has already recorded some voiceover work for the upcoming second season of Creature Commandos, where his character Eric Frankenstein will be part of the new episodes. James Gunn has previously indicated that Season 2 is expected to arrive after the July 2027 release of Man of Tomorrow.

Are you ready for more adventures with Frankenstein and the team? 🧟‍♂️🎬

#DavidHarbour #CreatureCommandos #DCU
